published_title: Why Ta Mère look like Ketwol Ver 3 76
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Crusher''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: Thats a SWCCG deck that beat the sh1t out of Dominic Gaudreault 8 games in a row last Friday.. its really good
cards: posted: You May Start Your Ketwol
posted: War Room of the Deed Start
posted: Darth Vader With PapaRevo x2
posted: I Have You Now ketwoooool x2
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Hoth: Ice Plains, Prepared Defenses, You May Start Your Landing, 'Orange Crush' and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60. No objective is listed, so the starting location is Hoth: Ice Plains.

'Blue Jello' and 'RED Shield' each stand alone between blank lines like the 'Locations' and 'Characters' headers, and the list totals exactly 60 without them, so they are treated as section headers (vehicles; Effects/Interrupts) and dropped.

The author uses 'Ketwol' as a filler word: 'You May Start Your Ketwol' dested You May Start Your Landing; 'I Have You Now ketwoooool' I Have You Now; 'Monok/ketwol' the Reflections II combo Evader & Monnok (the same author's 'monnok & evader' in DeckTech 18505).
Posted 'Do Or Donut Combo' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, as with the same author's 'do or donut & ...' in DeckTech 18147 and 18505.

Posted 'Defensive Peremetis' dested the Dark Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (listed under Locations); the strategy says the deck has only two exterior Hoth sites (Ice Plains and Defensive Perimeter; Wampa Cave is interior). 'Wampus Cave' dested Hoth: Wampa Cave; 'Deed Star' Death Star; 'War Room of the Deed Start' Death Star: War Room; 'Execoto Meditationer Chambery' Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Dagubo Cave' Dagobah: Cave; 'Kashyyk' Kashyyyk (Dark).
Posted 'Coruscant (The Planet itself)' dested the Dark Special Edition Coruscant system (the Coruscant set was not out in June 2001).

Posted 'Zixor' dested Prince Xizor; 'Granus Grujanus' Janus Greejatus; 'Sim Alos' Sim Aloo; 'GA TRAWN' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Blix 2' Blizzard 2; 'Jaba trou With You' Jabba's Through With You; 'Operation As Planed' Operational As Planned.
'Orange Crush' is printed as written; it is a starting Effect pulled by Prepared Defenses, probably Crush The Rebellion, but the name does not settle it.
'Grapler' is printed as written: several Dark cards fit 'Grabber' (the same author's 'grabbler' in DeckTech 18147 was also left as written).
Secret Plans, Come Here You Big Coward and No Escape were Effects in 2001, not Defensive Shields.

The identical list was posted under the same title by Dominic Gaudreault the day before ([http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16435 DeckTech 16435], [[Dominic Gaudreault Why Ta Mère look like Ketwol Ver 3 76]]).

"Boba Feet with shoes" and "IG 88 with his engine" are joke names that do not say which printing; they are printed as posted (likely Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle and IG-88 With Riot Gun or IG-88 In IG-2000).
